ORDER BY
n.read_count ${sortOrder}, n.id DESC

n.id DESC

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.read_count, n.created_at, n.is_fixed, u.fullname as writerName FROM community_notice n JOIN user u ON n.writer = u.id WHERE n.deleted_at IS NULL AND n.is_fixed = 1 ORDER BY n.updated_at DESC

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.read_count, n.created_at, n.is_fixed, n.writer as writerId, u.fullname as writerName FROM community_notice n JOIN user u ON n.writer = u.id WHERE n.id = #{id} AND n.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_notice (title, content, writer, is_fixed) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{writerId}, #{isFixed})
mapper.update: UPDATE community_notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_fixed = #{isFixed}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
